questions.query: If I upload an object using an existing key in a versioning-enabled S3 bucket, is the previous object overwritten?
questions.reference_answer: Amazon S3 adds a new object version. The previous version remains in the bucket as a noncurrent version and can be restored.

questions.query: In a versioning-enabled S3 bucket, how does deleting by key alone differ from deleting by key and a specific version ID?
questions.reference_answer: Deleting by key alone inserts a delete marker that becomes the current version. Specifying a version ID deletes that specific version; if it identifies the delete marker, removing the marker makes the object reappear.

questions.query: Which query parameter does DeleteObject require to permanently remove one specific S3 object version?
questions.reference_answer: Use the versionId query parameter. It permanently deletes the specified version.
